prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1462; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The injury does not fit the crash: the impact was very light, yet the claimed injury is severe.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change. The patient reports low back pain with stiffness and muscle tightness across the lumbar region. Over the course of eight visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided stretching, and a home exercise program. Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced range of motion in forward flexion, consistent with a soft tissue strain. Neurological screening, including reflexes and sensation in the lower extremities, was within normal limits. Straight leg raise testing was negative. The reported severity of symptoms is considerably greater than what would ordinarily be expected from the mechanism described, and the course of treatment extended somewhat beyond the typical timeframe for a lumbar strain of this kind. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving the lower back. Billing records reviewed for this episode of care show no duplicate or repeated charges. Ongoing management includes continued home exercise and reassessment at follow-up.
